seed_group.theme: Contract and surface-model reconciliation for identity, worktree/lane ownership, trust-state, and Source Control boundaries

key_findings.summary: Contracts_V0 is closest to canonical ownership for requested/effective runtime identity naming, but downstream consumers remain inconsistent.
evidence: requested/effective account identity remains asymmetric downstream
addendum consolidation is incomplete
usage/storage/UI docs still weaken or rename canonical fields

key_findings.summary: Tier-era product model is still encoded in operator-facing docs despite newer addenda moving runtime concepts forward.
evidence: Orchestrator_Page keeps Tiers and multi-tab widget composition
Widget_System catalogs tier widgets and weak hostability rules
Run_Graph_View lacks full requested/effective identity and governance-object model

key_findings.summary: Usage/storage docs remain tier-centric and under-specify durable account-switch and pressure-episode history.
evidence: usage-feature aggregates around tier_id
storage-plan still splits tier-era event tables from newer attempt-centric records
no first-class durable switch/pressure history model

key_findings.summary: Projection freshness and degraded-trust behavior are cross-doc gaps with no shared persisted trust/freshness contract.
evidence: event-driven freshness implied in Orchestrator_Page, Widget_System, Run_Graph_View
no shared action-gating + fallback contract tied to trust state

key_findings.summary: GitHub account identity remains misaligned with canonical account model due to mutable provider login usage.
evidence: GitHub_API_Auth_and_Flows keys storage/routing on login
GitHub_Integration lacks requested/effective GitHub account display/routing contract

key_findings.summary: Historical lineage retention after worktree cleanup is a hard requirement and must not collapse references.
evidence: missing live worktree must render as historical/retired/removed
lineage must preserve worktree_id, path/branch snapshots, compare target/commit range, owning identity

key_findings.summary: Terminology and surface ownership decision is finalized: Source Control stays worktree-first while Orchestrator stays package/lane-first.
evidence: Source Control keeps Worktrees as primary object list
Orchestrator presents worktrees contextually with deep links
surface asymmetry is intentional and must be explicit

key_findings.summary: Source Control is a constrained side-panel and must use dense, selective metadata with progressive disclosure.
evidence: small/narrow panel constraint confirmed
use primary line + compact chips/icons + expandable details + deep links

contradictions_and_gaps: Canonical field naming in Contracts_V0 conflicts with downstream _persona_id usage and weakened identity blocks.
usage-feature and storage-plan retain provider_account_id without canonical ownership/deconfliction rule.
Orchestrator_Page and Widget_System disagree on widget hostability and portability.
Run_Graph_View/Orchestrator imply richer identity rendering than current data contracts guarantee.
GitHub docs preserve realm isolation but do not bind provider identity to stable internal account_id.
Worktree/lane ownership language still drifts between tier/subtask framing and package-lane framing.
candidate_fixes: Enforce one canonical requested/effective identity block from Contracts_V0 across UI/runtime/storage with explicit fallback/switch disclosure.
Replace tier-first attribution with attempt/node/lane/package/seam-aware attribution; keep tier only as compatibility alias where required.
Define shared projection-health/trust-state record family and require all operator surfaces to use it for action gating and fallback.
Recast Orchestrator ownership: Progress as widget-hosting operational tab; native deep-inspection tabs for seams/graph/evidence/history/ledger.
Make Source Control the Git/worktree mutation execution surface; keep Orchestrator as operational context and initiation surface.
Use stable internal account_id as storage/routing key for GitHub identity; keep login as provider disclosure metadata.
Formally separate lane lifecycle state, worktree filesystem state, and runtime blocked/recovery state.
Preserve historical lane/worktree lineage through archive/remove/cleanup paths with retained snapshots and references.
guardrails: Keep dirty_worktree and worktree_conflict as runtime-truth blocked reasons across surfaces.
Do not collapse projection trust/freshness vocabulary into preview/browser trust_tier.
Preserve strict realm separation between github_api and copilot_github.
Do not hide worktree as Source Control primary object; lane appears as ownership metadata there.

decisions.decision: Source Control remains worktree-first; Orchestrator remains package/seam/lane-first.
Source Control panel is constrained and must prioritize compact information hierarchy with drill-in affordances.
